package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/queryfields"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/parsers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/composeconfig"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
)

// ComposeConfigHandler exposes compose config endpoints.
type ComposeConfigHandler struct {
	Validator *validator.Validate
	CreateUC  composeconfig.CreateComposeConfig
	GetUC     composeconfig.GetComposeConfig
	UpdateUC  composeconfig.UpdateComposeConfig
	ListUC    composeconfig.ListComposeConfigs
	DeleteUC  composeconfig.DeleteComposeConfig
}

type createComposeConfigRequest struct {
	Title       string          `json:"title" validate:"required,min=1,max=255"`
	Description string          `json:"description" validate:"required,min=1"`
	Config      json.RawMessage `json:"config" validate:"required"`
	Status      *int            `json:"status" validate:"omitempty,oneof=0 1"`
	TechIDs     []int           `json:"tech_ids" validate:"required,min=1,dive,min=1"`
}

// Create handles POST /compose-config/create.
func (h ComposeConfigHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req createComposeConfigRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	if len(req.Config) == 0 {
		http.Error(w, "config is required", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	if len(req.TechIDs) == 0 {
		http.Error(w, "tech_ids is required", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	status := 0
	if req.Status != nil {
		status = *req.Status
	}
	cfg, err := h.CreateUC.Handle(r.Context(), composeconfig.CreateComposeConfigInput{
		Title:       req.Title,
		Description: req.Description,
		Config:      req.Config,
		TechIDs:     req.TechIDs,
		Status:      status,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": cfg.ID})
}

// Get handles GET /compose-config/get/{composeConfigID}.
func (h ComposeConfigHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "composeConfigID")
	cfg, techIDs, err := h.GetUC.Handle(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"id":          cfg.ID,
		"title":       cfg.Title,
		"description": cfg.Description,
		"config":      cfg.Config,
		"status":      cfg.Status,
		"tech_ids":    techIDs,
	})
}

type updateComposeConfigRequest struct {
	Title       *string          `json:"title" validate:"omitempty,min=1,max=255"`
	Description *string          `json:"description" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
	Config      *json.RawMessage `json:"config"`
	TechIDs     *[]int           `json:"tech_ids" validate:"omitempty,dive,min=1"`
	Status      *int             `json:"status" validate:"omitempty,oneof=0 1"`
}

// Update handles PUT /compose-config/update/{composeConfigID}.
func (h ComposeConfigHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "composeConfigID")
	var req updateComposeConfigRequest
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&req); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	if err := h.Validator.Struct(req); err != nil {
		writeValidationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	hasTitle := req.Title != nil
	hasDescription := req.Description != nil
	hasConfig := req.Config != nil
	hasTechs := req.TechIDs != nil
	hasStatus := req.Status != nil
	if !hasConfig && !hasTechs && !hasTitle && !hasDescription && !hasStatus {
		http.Error(w, "config, title, description, status or tech_ids required", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	if hasConfig && len(*req.Config) == 0 {
		http.Error(w, "config is required", http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
		return
	}
	techIDs := []int{}
	if req.TechIDs != nil {
		techIDs = *req.TechIDs
	}
	cfg, err := h.UpdateUC.Handle(r.Context(), composeconfig.UpdateComposeConfigInput{
		ID:             id,
		Title:          req.Title,
		Description:    req.Description,
		HasTitle:       hasTitle,
		HasDescription: hasDescription,
		Config:         derefRawMessage(req.Config),
		HasConfig:      hasConfig,
		TechIDs:        techIDs,
		HasTechs:       hasTechs,
		Status:         req.Status,
		HasStatus:      hasStatus,
	})
	if err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrValidation {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusUnprocessableEntity)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"id": cfg.ID})
}

func derefRawMessage(val *json.RawMessage) []byte {
	if val == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return *val
}

// List handles GET /compose-config/list.
func (h ComposeConfigHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	fieldsParam := r.URL.Query().Get("fields")
	f := queryfields.Parse(fieldsParam, queryfields.ComposeConfigAllowedFields)
	filters, err := parsers.ParseComposeConfigFilters(r, h.Validator)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
		return
	}
	configs, techIDs, total, err := h.ListUC.Handle(r.Context(), filters)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	if configs == nil {
		configs = []domain.ComposeConfig{}
	}
	items := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(configs))
	for _, cfg := range configs {
		item := map[string]any{}
		if f.Has("id") {
			item["id"] = cfg.ID
		}
		if f.Has("title") {
			item["title"] = cfg.Title
		}
		if f.Has("description") {
			item["description"] = cfg.Description
		}
		if f.Has("config") {
			item["config"] = cfg.Config
		}
		if f.Has("status") {
			item["status"] = cfg.Status
		}
		if f.Has("created_at") {
			item["created_at"] = cfg.CreatedAt
		}
		if f.Has("tech_ids") {
			item["tech_ids"] = techIDs[cfg.ID]
		}
		items = append(items, item)
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{
		"compose_configs": items,
		"meta":            buildPaginationMeta(filters.Page, filters.Limit, total),
	})
}

// Delete handles DELETE /compose-config/delete/{composeConfigID}.
func (h ComposeConfigHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "composeConfigID")
	if err := h.DeleteUC.Handle(r.Context(), id); err != nil {
		if err == domain.ErrNotFound {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		if err == domain.ErrConflict {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusConflict)
			return
		}
		http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}
